---
title: "Deal report"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
params:
  tables: "../data/deal_report"
  money_unit: 1000000
  money_label: "m"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
# The deal report template, R version. It holds no data: every number comes
# from the tidy tables in params$tables, whose columns are set out in
# docs/guides/submission-schema.md ("The report's tables"). Render with
#   quarto render deal_report.qmd -P tables:<folder>
# A missing table or column stops the render with its name.
need <- list(
  deal.csv = c("item", "value"),
  structures.csv = c("structure", "item", "value"),
  metrics.csv = c("structure", "section", "item", "statistic", "value")
)
optional <- list(actual_vs_expected.csv = c("period", "actual", "expected", "ratio", "std_dev", "z"))

read_table <- function(name, columns) {
  path <- file.path(params$tables, name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("the report needs ", path)
  x <- utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  missing <- setdiff(columns, names(x))
  if (length(missing)) stop(name, " has no column ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  x
}
tables <- Map(read_table, names(need), need)
ave_path <- file.path(params$tables, names(optional))
ave <- if (file.exists(ave_path)) read_table(names(optional), optional[[1]]) else NULL

deal <- setNames(tables$deal.csv$value, tables$deal.csv$item)
structures <- tables$structures.csv
metrics <- tables$metrics.csv
names_of <- unique(structures$structure)

money <- function(x) sprintf("%s%s", formatC(x / params$money_unit, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ","), params$money_label)
percent <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)
plain <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)

# One section of metrics.csv as a table: a row per structure and item, a column per statistic, in file order.
section_table <- function(section, format, items = NULL) {
  x <- metrics[metrics$section == section, ]
  if (!is.null(items)) x <- x[x$item %in% items, ]
  if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
  stats <- unique(x$statistic)
  rows <- unique(x[c("structure", "item")])
  for (s in stats) {
    v <- x[x$statistic == s, ]
    key <- paste(v$structure, v$item)
    rows[[s]] <- vapply(paste(rows$structure, rows$item), function(k) {
      i <- match(k, key)
      if (is.na(i)) "" else format(v$value[i], v$item[i], s)
    }, "")
  }
  rownames(rows) <- NULL
  rows
}
show <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) cat("Not in the tables.\n") else print(knitr::kable(x, align = c("l", "l", rep("r", ncol(x) - 2))))
```

`r deal[["cedant"]]`, `r deal[["line_of_business"]]`. Treaty period
`r deal[["period_start"]]` to `r deal[["period_end"]]`, valued at
`r deal[["valuation_date"]]`. Amounts in `r deal[["currency"]]`,
`r deal[["simulations"]]` simulations.

## Structures

```{r}
#| label: structures
#| results: asis
wide <- reshape(structures, idvar = "item", timevar = "structure", direction = "wide")
names(wide) <- sub("^value\\.", "", names(wide))
for (s in names_of) {
  v <- wide[[s]]
  wide[[s]] <- ifelse(is.na(v), "", ifelse(grepl("premium", wide$item), money(v), percent(v)))
}
print(knitr::kable(wide, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", length(names_of)))))
```

## Loss ratio

The treaty's loss ratio and the ratios that make up its result, as fractions
of the ceded premium, in each structure.

```{r}
#| label: loss-ratio
#| results: asis
show(section_table("loss_ratio", function(v, item, stat) percent(v)))
```

## Ceded and net

The cedant's loss in the treaty year, ceded to and kept from each structure.

```{r}
#| label: layers
#| results: asis
show(section_table("layers", function(v, item, stat) money(v)))
```

## Investor returns

The investor's annual IRR and multiple on invested capital (MOIC) over the
term. `Lower TVaR 5` is the mean of the worst 5% of simulations;
`Probability of loss` is the share of simulations with an IRR below 0 or a
MOIC below 1. Simulations whose flows have no IRR are left out of the IRR's
statistics and counted.

```{r}
#| label: returns
#| results: asis
show(section_table("returns", function(v, item, stat) {
  if (stat == "Simulations without a root") format(v)
  else if (stat == "Probability of loss" || item == "irr") percent(v) else plain(v)
}))
```

## Structures compared

The mean amounts of each structure, with their ratio to its premium.

```{r}
#| label: comparison
#| results: asis
show(section_table("comparison", function(v, item, stat) if (stat == "Mean") money(v) else plain(v)))
```

## Monitoring: actual against expected

Each period's actual amount against what was expected of it, their ratio,
the expected amount's standard deviation under the model and the z-score
of the difference, about standard normal while the model holds.

```{r}
#| label: monitoring
#| results: asis
if (is.null(ave)) {
  cat("No actual against expected table yet: it is filled once the deal has a valuation after binding.\n")
} else {
  ave$actual <- money(ave$actual)
  ave$expected <- money(ave$expected)
  ave$std_dev <- money(ave$std_dev)
  ave$ratio <- plain(ave$ratio)
  ave$z <- sprintf("%.2f", ave$z)
  print(knitr::kable(ave, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(ave) - 1))))
}
```
